title: 道富资管日债专家：日本国债曲线交易，陡峭化还是平坦化？
speaker: Masahiko Hikulu

segments.en: I mean, where are you seeing the most opportunities on the curve? I think the, you know, for shorter, in the short term, it's still a steepening trade, right? Just because of the small fiscal concern, the small fiscal spending coming in from Takaheji, but going to 2020, 27 next year, I think it's a flattening trend in the curve, right?
segments.zh: 您在曲线上看到最多机会在哪里？我认为短期内，仍然是陡峭化交易，因为高市带来的小幅财政担忧和财政支出，但到2027年明年，我认为曲线是平坦化趋势。

segments.en: Just because of, you know, longer end has a lot of foreigners buying, right? They stop buying in July for certain reason, because the global market's sold off, right? But then if you look at the recent data, they are still net buying every month, at least, you know, 8 to 10 billion dollars, so there's a lot of money coming in in Japan, right?
segments.zh: 因为长端有很多外国买家。他们在7月因全球市场抛售而停止购买。但如果你看最近数据，他们仍然每月净买入至少80到100亿美元，所以有很多资金流入日本。

segments.en: And why are they buying the longer end of Japan is because it's more attractive for them versus other places, right? And in the front end, you know, JGB curve, BOJ will continue to hike, right? To that terminal, so that will, technically, into 2020, 2021, it's the trade that, you know, will investors will be looking into putting?
segments.zh: 他们为什么购买日本长端，因为相对于其他地方更有吸引力。在前端，日本国债曲线，日本央行将继续加息至终端利率，所以技术上，到2027年，这是投资者将考虑进行的交易。

segments.en: Is the sense in Japan, among you, in your sort of circle and network, expectation that rates are likely going to go up significantly more? Or is it almost your point on a meeting to meeting basis? I think it's more like, you know, it's not significantly a lot more, but sure, there's a bit of leeway for yield to go up, right?
segments.zh: 在日本，您的圈子和网络中，是否预期利率会大幅上升？还是几乎每次会议都如此？我认为并不是大幅上升，但确实有一点收益率上升的空间。

segments.en: Terminal is something, you know, people market is pricing around 2.4 to 0.5% now, right? If you look at two-year one-year JGB swap, right? So that is like terminal, like market signaling, but if you look, economists, that's almost double different level. Correct. So, honestly, they are talking about around 2%, for us, we think it's about 1.75, max, right?
segments.zh: 终端利率，市场现在定价在2.4%到0.5%左右，如果你看两年期一年期日本国债互换。所以这是终端，市场信号，但如果你看经济学家，几乎是两倍不同的水平。正确。所以老实说，他们谈论约2%，对我们来说，我们认为最高约1.75%。

segments.en: So for Japanese domestic, right, has actually shifted more to it than 1.75, and Japan, again, has a lot of cash. In the banking system, there's 400 trillion yen worth of cash. There's a lot of cash sitting in the system, right? So the cash are not being deployed now because no one wants to catch the following knives, right? When BOJ height closer to the 1.75 terminal, that's when domestic will start, you know, putting money, deploying money into the JGB market.
segments.zh: 所以对于日本国内，实际上已经更多转向1.75%以上，日本再次拥有大量现金。银行体系中有400万亿日元现金。大量现金闲置在系统中。所以现金现在没有被部署，因为没人想接飞刀。当日本央行加息接近1.75%终端时，国内将开始将资金部署到日本国债市场。
